Name: Less Fair Bear Family - Rebalanced Shop Prices
Author: MawDaSplatyBox2
Description:
This rebalance mod for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16197]Bear Family[/url] changes the prices at Gunnar's shop and the Bears' vending machine, making things more expensive by default and providing config options to change the price scaling. Additionally, sell values for various items have been adjusted so that they can't be easily resold for profits, including cooked items.

[b][size=4]Config[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Gunnar's Generosity[/b] - Worried about committing the cardinal sin of erasing Gunnar's gorgeous generous prices? Use this config to make prices more Gunnar-like 😇, or take the other path and make the shop even more expensive 👿.
[*][b]Year One Generosity[/b] - A different generosity level can be set for the first year on the farm. Gunnar may optionally give more affordable prices while the farmer's starting out, or make the shop unaffordable for the whole year.
[*][b]Additional Price Settings[/b] - Customise the pricing for Adventure Caches, Weak Rings, booze, more expensive Potions and the Ferseken Peach Sapling.
[*][b]Pumpkin & Peach Cola[/b] - Change the price and value of joja cola bought from the Bears' vending machine.
[*][b]Bramble Berry Edibility[/b] - Change how much energy and health bramble berries restore.
[*][b]Bonus[/b] - Feeling lucky? Bring the power of 7 to the Remedy All's luck and price.
[/list]
[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]
